cwe_content.cwe: CWE-611,Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

candidate.Reason: TransformerFactory.newInstance().newTransformer() creates a transformer without disabling XML external entity (XXE) processing. This allows XML documents with external entity references to be processed, potentially leading to XXE attacks.
Uses getTransformer() which creates an insecure transformer without XXE protection to process potentially untrusted XML content from sourceResponse parameter.
DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance().newDocumentBuilder() creates a document builder without disabling external entity processing, making it vulnerable to XXE attacks when processing XML content.
